statements.t: Hostetler continued, “While our updated full-year guidance reflects shifts in the timing of certain project deliveries, underlying customer demand remains strong and our continued operational execution and cost discipline are driving improved gross margin expectations.
We now expect full-year Adjusted Gross Margin (2) to be approximately 27%.
As a result, for the year ending December 31, 2026, the Company now expects:
For the quarter ending December 31, 2026, the Company expects revenue to be in the range of $445 million to $505 million.
